offence_note: Four counts possession for trafficking; failing to remain at accident scene
sentence_quote: On Count 3, possession of fentanyl for the purpose of trafficking, I sentence you to 14 months' imprisonment.
note: 14 months plus 45 days consecutive; no pretrial custody; victim surcharge waived.

offence_note: Serious offences not described; firearm prohibition and probation noted
note: Brief endorsement; leave granted, appeal dismissed; sentence length and offences not shown.

offence_note: Two offences against her young daughter; not specified
sentence_quote: The appellant’s conduct in relation to her own very young daughter is entirely deserving of a two year global sentence.
note: Global two years upheld; weapons prohibition shortened from 16 to 15 years on fresh evidence.

offence_note: Two convenience store robberies with a knife present
sentence_quote: I am going to impose a sentence of two and a half years, which is 30 months, in addition to the time you have already served.
note: Joint submission; 30 months plus time served, effectively four years; federal institution requested by offender.

offence_note: Canada Labour Code safety offence causing worker's drowning death (corporate)
sentence_quote: A fine of $75,000 to be paid on or before December 23, 2022
note: Corporate offender; probation condition of $15,000 charitable donation to Threads of Life.

sentence_quote: the person shall be sentenced to imprisonment for life without eligibility for parole until that person has served 25 years of that sentence. I impose that sentence on you today, Ms. Athwal.

offence_note: Large cocaine importation and trafficking, criminal organization, proceeds of crime
co_offenders: Kompon: life imprisonment; fine in lieu of forfeiture set aside
sentence_quote: I would grant the Crown leave to appeal the sentences and allow the appeals. I would: (i) substitute a sentence of life imprisonment on each of the Respondents for count 3
note: Crown appeal allowed; sentences on counts 1, 2 unchanged; count 4 stayed; mitigating from sentencing judge.

offence_note: Robbery of elderly man; resisting peace officer; breach of probation and release
sentence_quote: the Court suspends the passing of sentence and places Mr Wright on probation for a period of 24 months
note: Preliminary 390 days, remand credit 397.5 days exceeds it, so sentence suspended; victim surcharge waived.

offence_note: Aggravated assault, stab wound to neck
sentence_quote: the appellant was sentenced to two years less a day imprisonment in addition to 7 months credit for pre-sentence custody

offence_note: Firearm possession offences including s. 117.01 breach
sentence_quote: we reduce the sentence for the firearm offences, other than for count number 4, to three years’ imprisonment less one year for the pre-sentence custody.

offence_note: Possession of crack cocaine for the purpose of trafficking

note: Twelve months less 3.5 months pre-trial custody; conditional sentence rightly rejected.

sentence_quote: On July 18, 2019, Devlin J. sentenced the appellant to a total of 18 months' imprisonment (reduced to time served due to extensive pre-trial custody) and a three-year term of probation.
